EventStagedInviteeEmail.name: EventStagedInviteeEmail
EventStagedInviteeEmail.description: Represents the relationship between an event and an email address invited to the event that doesn’t match to a user, contact, or lead record. Data about the unmatched email address is represented in StagedInviteeEmail. This object represents event-related details, such as the invitee's attendance response to the event.

EventId.description: The unique ID of the related event record.

IsArchived.description: Indicates whether the event is archived (true) or not (false). This value helps manage high volumes of archived events, improving query performance.

IsOrganizer.description: Indicates whether the invitee is the event organizer (true) or not (false).

StagedInviteeEmailId.description: The unique ID of the related invitee email address record.

Status.description: The attendance response to the event from the invitee.

EventStagedInviteeEmail.accessRules: This object is available with Einstein Activity Capture when Sync Email as Salesforce Activity is turned on.
